note: P48-T03 reach map measured with the process httptest server, not the constructor: a mounted route answers beyond the registry placeholder (never structural 404/501 on an applicable call); a declared route no surface claims keeps the placeholder 404 of a module not composed yet. declaration = declared in routes.go/contract; mounted = served by the composed process in the environment; validated = full browser journey proven, claimed by no surface here — browser validation lands in P49+. No business machine was changed for this map; no external provider is called and no real data is used.

test.note: dbtest disposable PostgreSQL + fakeemail sink; participation requires CursorSecret like production.

development.note: like test plus the hashed frontend build; participation mounted only with ARENA_CURSOR_SECRET, else warn and serve account+health.

production.note: like development with provider email delivery; missing CursorSecret refuses the boot instead of shipping the gap silently.

no-database.note: without ARENA_DATABASE_URL only the platform probes answer; every other declaration keeps its placeholder.

surfaces.name: health
surfaces.note: Platform probes answered by the platform itself; no surface may claim them.

surfaces.name: account
surfaces.note: Twelve identity HTML documents (P18-T05) plus the identity JSON API mounted beside them by the same composer (P49-T01).

surfaces.name: participation
surfaces.note: Arena page plus four authenticated transitions (P18-T06). /d/{slug} stays declaration-only until P49-T03.

surfaces.name: static-build
surfaces.note: Hashed frontend build served by the process; declares no registry routes, takes no part in the contract comparison.

surfaces.name: arena-document
surfaces.note: Cacheable public Arena document mounted by ComposeArenaLifecycle beside the JSON lifecycle (P49-T03); proven via process httptest+PG alongside draft publish, feed and search.

surfaces.name: identity-api
surfaces.note: Auth/MFA/session JSON mounted by ComposeAccount over the same pool/security/throttle/CSRF as the pages (P49-T01); proven via process httptest+PG: register-login-sessions-logout, 401, rotation, revocation.

surfaces.name: profiles-api
surfaces.note: Public/private profile, personal export request/download and deletion request/status/cancel mounted by ComposeAccountPrivacy over the same pool/security/session validator as the account journey (P49-T02); proven via process httptest+PG: owner-vs-other, replay idempotence, no-store, single-use download.

surfaces.name: arenas-api
surfaces.note: Draft CRUD, publish spending one pass, close, feed and public document JSON mounted by ComposeArenaLifecycle over the same pool/security/session validator with a cursor secret (P49-T03); proven via process httptest+PG: draft-publish-feed-document, owner-vs-stranger, forged cursor refused, idempotent close replay. HTML participation is unaffected.

surfaces.name: positions-api
surfaces.note: Position confirm/change/history plus the public aggregate mounted by ComposeDebateAttribution over the same pool/security/session validator (P49-T04); proven via process httptest+PG: confirm, idempotent reconfirm, change, owner reads, public aggregate, stranger 404, anonymous 401. The attribution record moved to the mounted persuasion-api surface in P49-T04.

surfaces.name: arguments-api
surfaces.note: Publish/reply/withdraw plus public list/replies/get mounted by ComposeDebateAttribution with the shared cursor secret and the INK debit bridge (P49-T04); proven via process httptest+PG: publish spending INK, idempotent replay, reply, forged cursor refused, withdraw retracts content, insufficient INK rolls back.

surfaces.name: persuasion-api
surfaces.note: Attribution recording, public counts, factual reputation and the moderator-only signals read mounted by ComposeDebateAttribution, the signals gate answered from the moderation role store (P49-T04); proven via process httptest+PG: record, idempotent replay, metrics, reputation, foreign change 404, non-moderator 403. Case competence and decisions stay with P49-T07.

surfaces.name: search-api
surfaces.note: Arena and argument full-text search mounted by ComposeArenaLifecycle with the shared cursor secret (P49-T03); proven via process httptest+PG: anonymous search finds the published Arena, forged cursor refused.

surfaces.name: transparency
surfaces.note: Public metrics, the localized HTML document and the versioned Arena export mounted by ComposeTransparency over the process pool, clock and cursor secret (P49-T08). Unauthenticated by design: no session validator and no security boundary, because there is no identity to resolve. Proven via process httptest+PG: suppressed small-sample counts, exact period echo, unknown locale falling back without reflection, public cache with ETag/304, withdrawn content null with no sources, 404 without reflection and forged cursor 400, no seeded email or account id in any body. metrics/pprof stay off this surface.

surfaces.name: wallet-billing-reads
surfaces.note: Passes/history/subscription reads mounted by ComposeEntitlementReads over the same pool/security/session validator with a cursor secret (P49-T05); proven via process httptest+PG: owner-vs-other, reload grants nothing, forged cursor refused, subscription projection without provider identifiers, private no-store. Checkout/portal writes stay with P49-T06.

surfaces.name: wallet-billing
surfaces.note: Guarded checkout/portal writes mounted by ComposeBillingWrites over the same pool/security/session validator with the versioned catalog and the synthetic gateway in tests (P49-T06); the provider-only webhook pipeline settles INK/passes/Member on verified events, production refuses the incomplete composition (no webhook secret configured) instead of faking payment. Proven via process httptest+PG: checkout→verified event→projection, browser return grants nothing, forged/replay guarded, provider down grants nothing, private no-store.

surfaces.name: moderation-api
surfaces.note: Reports/appeals/cases/claim/decisions mounted by ComposeModeration over the same pool/security/session validator with a cursor secret (P49-T07); the triage routes require an active assignment plus a stepped-up session read from the same role store the debate signals gate answers from. Proven via process httptest+PG: 401/403/MFA, double claim and lapsed lease 409, conflicting decision 409, audited decision row, no self-promotion route. No role is granted over HTTP.

surfaces.name: jobs-admin
surfaces.p49: contract in P49-T09, then guarded composition
surfaces.note: Three operator routes without a published contract; P49-T09 closes the contract (operator/role/MFA) before composing.

surfaces.name: staged-seasons
surfaces.note: Staged season reads proven only in the separate synthetic harness (P56); the delivered server keeps the placeholder.

surfaces.name: staged-metering
surfaces.note: Staged metering quote/publication/receipt/statement proven only in the harness (P56/P57).

surfaces.name: staged-commerce
surfaces.note: Staged trade receipt/statement proven only in the harness (P56/P57); no commercial transfer is activated.

surfaces.name: staged-disputes
surfaces.note: Staged private case file proven only in the harness (P56/P57).

surfaces.name: wallet
surfaces.note: Legacy ledger reads (balance + statement) mounted by ComposeAccountPrivacy over the same pool/security/session validator with a cursor secret (P49-T02); proven via process httptest+PG: owner-vs-other, forged cursor refused, no-store.

p49_plan: keep: health, static-build, account, participation (P18 journeys stay mounted)
P49-T01: mount identity-api (auth/MFA/session JSON) reusing the account security/pool
P49-T02: mount profiles-api (public profile, private profile, export/download, deletion)
P49-T03: mount arena-document, arenas-api and search-api (lifecycle + search JSON)
P49-T04: mount positions-api, arguments-api and persuasion-api (debate + factual reputation)
P49-T05: mount wallet-billing reads (passes/history/subscription); no benefit on read
P49-T06: compose guarded wallet-billing writes (checkout/portal) with synthetic gateway in tests
P49-T07: mount moderation-api with competence and step-up; never grant roles over HTTP
P49-T08: mount transparency (metrics document + export + HTML)
P49-T09: close the jobs-admin contract, then compose guarded operator surfaces
staged-seasons/metering/commerce/disputes: stay declaration-only in the delivered server; harness-only in P56/P57
